entry.title: Atom entry with full content
entry.summary: A complete Atom entry, including XHTML content.
entry.content:
Atom can carry the whole article. This entry includes several paragraphs so the reader treats it as full content rather than an excerpt.

The body is sanitised, links open in a new tab, and images are lazy loaded. Nothing here is fetched at render time; the HTML was stored with the article when the feed refreshed.

That is the whole trick: parse once, store once, render cheaply.
